subject.title: [Feature]: Compaction: configurable model override + flush-then-reset mode

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in `memoryFlush.resetAfterFlush`-style mode that skips compaction and resets after a successful memory flush?
rationale: The remaining request is not a narrow bug fix: it changes session lifecycle, durable-memory assumptions, security boundaries, and provider routing after maintenance turns.

options.title: Design opt-in reset mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the guards, config shape, proof, and interaction with pre-reset memory flush before implementation.

options.title: Fold into pre-reset memory design
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45608 as the canonical reset-safety design and close or narrow this issue to compaction cost only.

options.title: Reject automatic reset
options.body: Keep compaction as the recovery mechanism after successful memory flush and document model overrides as the supported cost-control path.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in reset mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the guards, config shape, proof, and interaction with pre-reset memory flush before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current compaction, memory-flush, and reset-lifecycle code reviewed here is mostly tied to recent steipete/Peter Steinberger history.
